Analysis. These comments are related to the rule rather than the EIS and are discussed in the preamble to the final rule.
Vehicle Utilization
U. S. Department of Agriculture, Forest Service. The Forest Service expressed concern that fuel economy goals will force manufacturers to design tracks in a limited manner which inhibits their usefulness in a variety of applications. This, they feel, will force many purchasers to heavier, more costly, vehicles.
Analysis. NHTSA took this problem into account when developing the AFES for MY 1979. Research is being planned for future rulemaking activities to help NHTSA understand how NPA's are presently being used. Market shifts which could hurt particular manufacturers are also being considered.
